description: Agent skills for Australian accounting and tax preparation workflows (BAS, month-end close, payroll, FBT, Division 7A, trusts and returns), with primary-source checks, validation cards and human review gates.
rules: All skills are preparation-only workpaper workflows for review by a registered tax agent, BAS agent or qualified accountant; never lodge, post, pay or give tax advice.
Check primary sources (legislation.gov.au, ato.gov.au, state revenue offices, AASB) for mutable rates, thresholds, labels and due dates before relying on a figure.

Use the pinned aus-accounting MCP server configured in .claude-plugin/plugin.json (or the installed calculator binary) for deterministic Australian tax calculations rather than inventing tax arithmetic.
Keep real client TFNs, ABNs and live financial exports out of public repositories, URLs and unapproved model tools; use fabricated fixtures for examples.
Install from a tagged GitHub release when production stability is required; main holds unreleased changes and development routes.
